description: Crée moi une site internet de mécanique à domicile, changement d’huile, frein , entretien voiture et lavage automobile intérieur extérieur

designManifest.iconDirection: A flat emblem combining a wrench arc with a single inspection status dot (indigo) inside a rounded square stamp on warm paper ground — reads as a certified mobile service mark, no text.
designManifest.signatureMove: A 'code d'inspection' status-light system — each service is a numbered inspection row tagged with a green/amber/indigo pastille for entretien/réparation/esthétique — plus a framed 'fiche de service' hero and a mobile-only fixed Appeler / Réserver à domicile action bar.
designManifest.summary: The mobile mechanic is presented like a transparent multi-point vehicle inspection on warm garage-worksheet paper, with a green/amber/indigo status-light code guiding the eye and a persistent on-site booking bar keeping the next appointment one tap away.
designManifest.typography: Big Shoulders Display (industrial signage headings) + Schibsted Grotesk (humanist body) + DM Mono (worksheet labels & numerals)

promptHistory.prompt: Crée moi une site internet de mécanique à domicile, changement d’huile, frein , entretien voiture et lavage automobile intérieur extérieur
promptHistory.changeNotes:
Build initial complet d'un site de mécanique mobile à domicile (huile, freins, entretien, lavage). Identité « Inspection multipoint » : papier-atelier chaud, titres industriels Big Shoulders, pastilles de statut vert/ambre/indigo et barre d'action fixe Appeler/Réserver sur mobile. Pages : accueil, services, réservation (round-trip complet stockée en base + courriel), conseils, à propos, contact, mes rendez-vous (connexion OTP). Backend admin complet avec tableau de bord, CRUD des réservations/services/conseils/témoignages/messages, téléversement et génération IA d'images.

Admin enrichment: (1) Rebuilt admin module pages (shared admin-shell) with a search/filter toolbar, live count, horizontal-scroll table, status badges for bookings (Nouveau/Confirmé/Complété/Annulé) and star-rating display for testimonials, prioritized columns (status/rating always shown), richer empty state with inline '+ Ajouter' CTA, hover row highlight, '← Tableau de bord' back button and per-item label on the New button. Full CRUD (create/edit/delete modal, image upload + AI generation, all editable columns) preserved and intact. (2) Polished admin dashboard: accent on new-bookings stat, card headers with quick links, status badges in recent bookings, emoji-icon module cards under a 'Gérer le contenu' heading, friendlier empty states. (3) Added visible focus-visible states to admin and public CSS for accessibility; new utility classes (badge variants, stars, toolbar/search, table-scroll, empty-state). (4) Added Open Graph / Twitter social-sharing meta tags to the public header (uses hero image when present). All functional service fields (price, duration, category, featured, sort_order) were already admin-managed and remain so. No files removed; all {{IMG_*}} placeholder tokens preserved byte-for-byte.
